messages:
infra-bot: Incident opened -> transit firewall changes causing control-plane egress failures in eu-west-2. Detected 1987654321. Customer impact: private deployments intermittently fail to connect (502/504). Status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-7723 :rotating_light:

lee (oncall): seeing repeated `connect timeout` and `connection reset` from transit-proxy logs. Correlation with a batch of firewall rule updates deployed ~1987654200.

anika: I see PR #4912 applied a new denylist from provider. Provider appears to have expanded the denylist via their auto-block feature and included our control-plane egress CIDR.

ops_tl: rolling back the provider-side rule requires provider SR; immediate mitigation option: add explicit allow rule for control-plane CIDR at transit layer and restart transit agents. Start now. ETA 20m.

support_triage: preparing a short customer bulletin acknowledging partial outage in eu-west-2 private deployments and noting engineers are rolling mitigations. Draft: "We are investigating connectivity issues for private deployments in eu-west-2. Engineers are deploying an emergency allowlist and will provide updates on https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-7723."

lee (oncall): applied transit allowlist entry at 1987654380 for 10.84.128.0/20 -> control-plane egress. Restarting transit proxies in a rolling manner.

anika: rolling restarts in progress. Observability: control-plane handshake success rising from ~55% -> 85% after first wave. Continuing.

infra-bot: metric update: control-plane handshake success (eu-west-2) 55% -> 92% over 8 minutes post-mitigation.

ops_tl: provider SR opened to request removal of auto-expanded denylist entries; asked provider to confirm why our CIDR was included. Ticket: SR-89331.

platform_pm: requested customer-impact list from billing to coordinate comms and prioritize enterprise outreach.

support_triage: sent initial customer message at 1987654450 to all affected accounts; will follow-up with RCA.

lee (oncall): verifying full recovery across tenants. Two tenants reported lingering reconnect loops; escalated to solutions-eng for in-tenant troubleshooting and token refresh checks.

anika: action items for post-incident: 1) Add explicit transit allowlist in IaC for control-plane CIDRs, 2) Add infra e2e test to simulate provider denylist expansion on staging, 3) Add alert if control-plane handshake success <90% for 10m in any region, 4) Document provider auto-block caveats in runbook.

ops_tl: RCA owner assigned to anika. Please produce draft RCA and publish to /docs/incidents/INC-7723 within 48h. Keep incident open until RCA posted and allowlist validated for 24h.

infra-bot: Incident status -> mitigated. Channel will receive final postmortem link once RCA is published."
